'''Defel-nator Dark Side 1995 Overkill (MISC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Defel-nator]]
* '''Published:''' 4 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: War Room|Premiere-D-deathstarwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Death Star War Room Defel-nator DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Would you have built this deck back then?

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

I clearly remember being told that the ultimate DS card had been found, and it was a common.  I did not belive until I was scanning crewwed to death in 3 stright games and leared to hate that card... that and the fact that I only owned 2 or 3 copies of sense.

Well, the deck is pretty simple - except for locations.  I found that the threat of Revo early meant lots of different locations to get your force generation up and hopefully a quick vader and alter...

the key is Sense/Alter - win this and you will win the game because you need to stop LS retrvial.
